title: MZ Error message when I open the visustella sample game project with the game testing system.

posts.author: ikolit
posts.body:
I don't know why, but I keep getting this error message when trying to use the game testing system inside RMMZ for the visustella sample game project and any other projects with the plug ins from the sample game (this one
https://visustella.itch.io/visumz-sample
).
I've tried updating the corescript and updating the plug ins separately but it still shows the error when I try to open the game.
When trying to use the plug ins from the sample project on my own project, and opening it with the game testing system it jumped the start menu all-together and wouldn't show me the title page for the game either.
It doesn't give me the same error when I export the game and run it as a finished project.
I'm very new to rpg maker mz, I'm not sure if this is a common error. If anyone knows what is wrong or how to solve it, I would really appreciate it.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
So I'm not sure, but I think you're talking about this:
Despite the word "error" in there, this is not an error - that would be red and prevent the game from running.
This is just a warning, and it's present in all RPG Maker MZ games.
ikolit said:
I'm very new to rpg maker mz
Click to expand...
My personal suggestion would be to not mess around with plugins very much if you're very new to MZ. I'd suggest you focus on doing a few series of tutorials and make some short practice games to understand how MZ's engine works by default, and to get comfortable with events.
We see a fair number of people who jump into plugins right away and then ask silly questions, not knowing that what they want is actually how MZ would work
without
the plugins.
Good luck with your project!
